metadata.title: Students & Contests — AlgoCoach
metadata.description: Structured algorithm practice for CS students and competitive programmers: real execution, guided hints, assessments, and review.

hero.title: Connect coursework and contest training in one path

introduce.title: Course concepts need a runnable practice loop

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Common questions from students and contest learners.

items.question: Is this good for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Guided problems and progressive hints help you start from a blank editor.

items.question: Can I focus on specific topics?
items.answer: Yes. Filter the catalog by topic and difficulty.

items.question: What syncs after sign-in?
items.answer: Practice history, assessments, review cards, and progress.

cta.title: Start one structured problem today
